prompts.musashi:

ONE full body character, centered with generous transparent padding, 3/4 top-down FRONT view facing camera. No antialiasing, no gradients, no blur, no outer glow, no ground shadow, no text or frame. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Grounded combat-ready neutral pose, not floating. Subject: Musashimaru, a massive Japanese armored samurai boss. Broad burgundy lacquered lamellar cuirass, sweeping broad rectangular shoulder guards, a closed battered iron menpo faceplate with angry visible eyes, kabuto helmet with two short plain curved iron horns, NO gold crown. Two hands grip an exceptionally long silver curved katana diagonally down across his front, tip near the ground; both feet firmly apart. Heavy intimidating silhouette distinct from an agile ninja, indigo underskirt, steel and weathered muted brass rivets.
